class.name: WorldFire
class.brief_description: The fire contract: where fire burns and has burnt, as the other world systems read it.
class.description: Answers for every live fire producer at once ([code]PhysXFireSpread3D[/code]): the most heat and the most burnt of any of them at a point. With none, both are 0. The weather dries the surface water under a fire from [method heat_at]. Get it from [WorldContracts]; a test extends it in a script and sets it with [method WorldContracts.set_fire].

method.name: _burnt_at
method.description: Override in a stub to replace [method burnt_at].

method.name: _heat_at
method.description: Override in a stub to replace [method heat_at].

method.name: _stem_char_at
method.description: Override in a stub to replace [method stem_char_at].

method.name: _wind_at
method.description: Override in a stub to replace [method wind_at].

method.name: burnt_at
method.description: How burnt the ground at [param position] is, 0 unburnt to 1 burnt out.

method.name: has_provider
method.description: Whether any fire producer is live.

method.name: heat_at
method.description: The fire's heat release over the ground at [param position] now, in W/m2; 0 where nothing burns.

method.name: stem_char_at
method.description: How deep a stem standing at [param position] has charred at its foot, in metres of bark and wood: the time flames and smouldering logs stood there, at a charring rate of about 0.8 mm a minute (EN 1995-1-2). [TreeWind3D] weakens the stem's foot by it, so a burnt tree may snap there in a later storm. The most of any fire; 0 where none burnt.

method.name: wind_at
method.description: The wind the fires draw in near the ground at [param position], in m/s (horizontal): the indraft at the base of their plumes, toward the burning front, strongest within a few metres of it. Summed over the fires; it adds to [method WorldWeather.wind_at]. Zero where no fire is near.
